jobs.title: Senior Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced embedded engineer ready to take ownership of firmware platforms that keep critical water infrastructure connected and intelligent? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.

  

As our new Senior Product Development Engineer, you will be developing firmware and software on bespoke RTOS and Linux\-based hardware platforms, architecting solutions that connect sensors and telemetry units to cloud technologies for the water utility industry. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well\-being, and a sense of belonging.

 **What you will be doing:**

  

As a key part of the Devices Development team, you'll create impact by Delivering reliable, secure embedded solutions that enable water utilities to monitor and manage critical infrastructure through real\-time data collection and connectivity.

  

Your main responsibilities include:

  

* Architect, develop, and maintain firmware codebases on RTOS and Linux platforms, ensuring reliable data collection from sensors and telemetry units to cloud/server systems
* Drive automated testing methodologies and CI pipelines to improve release quality and reduce manual verification effort
* Mentor less experienced engineers, conduct code reviews, and raise awareness of best practices including cyber security
* Break down high\-level requirements into measurable tasks and lead development activities from New Product Introduction through to quality\-assured releases
* Resolve escalated customer issues across the full system stack — sensor, telemetry, communications, and software — and contribute to customer documentation and training

 **What makes you a great fit**

  

Above all, you are a hands\-on embedded engineer with deep C/C\+\+ expertise, strong ownership mentality, and the ability to lead technical initiatives while mentoring others in a collaborative team environment. We would also imagine that you have:

  

* Degree, HNC, or HND in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline with 5\+ years of C/C\+\+ embedded development experience
* Detailed knowledge of embedded systems, RTOS, TCP/IP networking, and serial communications (e.g. RS\-485\)
* Working knowledge of electronics and systems integration including microcontrollers, ADCs, power supplies, and transceivers
* Understanding of cyber security principles for embedded platforms and experience with continuous integration and build systems

  

It is a plus if you also have:

  

* Experience with Linux\-based embedded development and/or desktop application development (e.g. C\# WPF) or cloud computing
* Knowledge of industrial PLCs and protocols such as Modbus or DF1
* Experience using agile methodologies and ticketing systems such as Jira
**Why you will love working here**

  

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.
* Access to on\-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

  

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.

  

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

  

To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

jobs.title: Cloud Platforms Advisory Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Advisory Systems Engineer
  
  

Our field sales professionals rely on proactive technical support during the sales process – and our expert Systems Engineering team always steps up to the mark. We lead the development and implementation of complex and specialized products, applications, services and solutions. From delivering sales presentations and product demonstrations, to developing detailed installations or system integration plans, we ensure customers get the innovative, relevant, interoperable solutions they need.

The Cloud Platforms Advisory Systems Engineer is a customer\-facing presales technical leader who helps organizations adopt hybrid cloud, private cloud, HCI, and container platforms.
  
  

The role partners with account teams, customers, and technology partners throughout the opportunity lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through technical validation, proposal development, and handoff to delivery. The engineer translates business and technology objectives into secure, scalable, commercially viable solutions using Dell Private Cloud, VxRail, Kubernetes, and related technologies.

Advisory Systems Engineer
  
  

on our
  
  

Systems Engineering
  
  

team.

Bachelor’s degree

jobs.description:
**Job Title:**  

Software developer– Semiconductor Test (C\#, C\+\+, .NET)
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Design, implement, and test system software in support of both the IG\-XL development environment for the UltraFLEX family platform and Eagle software for the ETS platform.
  
  

System software supports all digital, RF, and analog instruments, runs on various operating systems; this team architects and develops core services used by the driver teams.
  
  

The team also selects computing hardware that best matches product requirements and ensures that the software can run as a 64\-bit application.
  
  

Duties will include developing and analyzing software requirements, developing functional specifications and design documents based on the requirements, implementation of the code using C\#, C\+\+, .NET and COM/ATL, and unit testing and verification of the code.
  
  

The candidate will be responsible for debugging and solving complex software and computing issues.
  
  

The candidate will interface with several organizations (Factory Applications, Release Teams, Sustaining Teams, and other project Teams) on a daily basis.
  
  

**Minimum Requirements:**  

BSCS, BSCE, BSEE, or equivalent.
  
  

**Desired:** More than 5 years' experience with in\-depth software development experience with commercial applications.
  
  

Project work involving developing software applications that control hardware products.
  
  

Solid grasp of Object\-Oriented Design and software data structures; UML is desirable.
  
  

Proficiency in C\#, C\+\+, and OOD required.
  
  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills of complex systems is required.
  
  

Working knowledge of VB required.
  
  

Ability to work as part of a software development team required.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

Knowledge of UML Design, Version Vault, and Git is a plus.
  
  

Ability to understand and debug a complex system is a plus.
  
  

Prior ATE experience and/or hardware knowledge is a plus.
  
  

Working knowledge of computing hardware is a plus.
  
  

Knowledge of Agile, CI, and JIRA is a plus
  
  

Infrasoft Technologies is a dedicated software company for the Banking \& Finance Industry. We help creating new business models with our software products, solutions and specialized services. We are an ISO9001 \& 27001 and CMMi Level 5 v1\.3 Company having a global foot print with operations in New York, London, Dubai, Bahrain, Malaysia, Singapore and Mumbai.
